mcp.question: A paid API request timed out after submission. Should a budget reservation be released immediately? Explain in at most 80 words.
mcp.context: Submission response was lost. Execution status is unknown. This is a reasoning-only adapter probe; do not use tools.

cost.basis: API-equivalent; peak DeepSeek, standard Astra; no subscription claim

first.advice: No. A timeout with a lost submission response does not prove the paid request failed or incurred no charge. Keep the reservation pending until reconciliation establishes the outcome. The decisive check is provider-side request status or billing evidence, ideally linked to a request or idempotency key. Release only confirmed unused funds; convert confirmed charges to actual spend. Avoid an unprotected retry that could create a duplicate charge.
